answer: An AI agent marketplace grants each seller account access only while its own $100 bond is locked, with a 30-day minimum. A bond cannot back multiple accounts, and closing an account cannot unlock it early. Aliases such as saffron, timber, and jetty each require separate bonds. Every extra fake identity therefore ties up another $100. If financing costs 1% per 30 days, its marginal carrying cost is $1 per period; the deposit itself remains recoverable.
